import unittest
from solution import merge_channels


class MergeChannelsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_round_robin_with_uneven_and_empty_channels(self):
        channels = [[1, 2, 3], [], ["a"], [True, False]]
        self.assertEqual(merge_channels(channels), [1, "a", True, 2, False, 3])
        self.assertEqual(merge_channels([]), [])
        self.assertEqual(merge_channels([[], []]), [])

    def test_input_is_not_mutated(self):
        channels = [[1, 2], [3]]
        before = [channel[:] for channel in channels]
        merge_channels(channels)
        self.assertEqual(channels, before)

    def test_output_elements_are_deep_copied_and_independent(self):
        shared = {"items": [1]}
        channels = [[shared, shared]]
        first = merge_channels(channels)
        first[0]["items"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(shared, {"items": [1]})
        self.assertEqual(first[1], {"items": [1]})
        self.assertIsNot(first[0], first[1])
        second = merge_channels(channels)
        first[1]["items"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(second, [{"items": [1]}, {"items": [1]}])

    def test_rejects_non_list_structure(self):
        for value in [None, (), [[], ()], ["abc"]]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    merge_channels(value)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
